class.identity_revoked_suspect: An identity confirmation was revoked as suspect

alert.raised: An alert was sent to the administrators.
alert.not_for_this_reason: No administrator alert was raised for this reason.
alert.not_configured: No administrator alert was raised: the alert settings are not configured yet.

rules.intro: The red-flag rule versions of this clinic, with the decisions made on each. Every phrase and pattern is shown exactly as the system holds it. This screen cannot write or change a rule.
rules.twoDoctors: A draft version becomes approved only when two different doctors approve it, each with a fresh authenticator code. One rejection closes the version. Nothing is approved by default.
rules.readOnly: You can read these rules and who decided on them. Only doctors decide.
rules.empty: There are no red-flag rule versions to show.
rules.vitalsNo: This version has no vital-sign criteria.
rules.noDecisions: Nobody has decided on this version yet.
rules.approveBody: You are approving exactly the content shown below. The version becomes approved only if a second, different doctor also approves it. The person who wrote a version cannot decide it.
rules.rejectBody: One rejection closes this version for good. It cannot be approved afterwards.
rules.youDecided: You have already decided on this version.

result.recorded: Your approval was recorded. The version is not approved yet: a second, different doctor must approve it.
result.approved: Your approval was recorded and this version is now approved.
result.rejected: Your rejection was recorded. This version is closed.
result.already_decided: You already decided on this version the other way. Nothing changed.
result.not_draft: This version is not a draft any more, so nothing was recorded.
result.origin_mismatch: This version belongs to a different environment than this clinic, so nothing was recorded.
result.author_cannot_decide: You wrote this version, so you cannot decide it. A different doctor must.
result.empty_rule: This version has no phrases, patterns or vital-sign criteria, so it cannot be approved.
result.rejected_earlier: A doctor already rejected this version, so it cannot be approved.
result.platform_rule: This rule applies to every clinic. Who may approve it has not been decided, so nothing was approved here.
result.unknown: The system answered with a result this screen does not know. Nothing is shown as approved. Reload the page to see the current state.
